topPRs.title: docs: retire the op-geth rewind and precompile tutorials
topPRs.author: donoso-eth
topPRs.body:
Retires the two chain-operator tutorials that still teach op-geth-only procedures. op-geth is five months past EOS and cannot follow the chain since Karst.

- **`rewind-op-geth`: deleted.** Its procedure needs `debug_setHead`, which op-reth does not implement, and nothing links to it. The URL redirects to the troubleshooting guide, which already covers `op-reth stage unwind`.
- **`adding-precompiles`: archived.** The concept is still valid; only the op-geth walkthrough is dead. Moved to `chain-operators/tutorials/archive/` with an Archived warning and the shared op-geth EOL snippet, until it is rewritten for op-revm.
- `docs.json`: nav and redirects updated; the existing `/operators/...` redirect is retargeted so it does not chain. Snippet consumer lists updated.

`lint:nav`, `lint:redirects` and `lint:reference` pass locally.

Reviews: `deletion-reviewer` swept the monorepo for surviving references to both URLs and found none. Its one low finding, that the troubleshooting page never uses the word "rewind", is dismissed: the page documents `op-reth stage unwind`, which is the op-reth equivalent, and the op-geth procedure has no replacement.

Tracks ethereum-optimism/solutions#693.
